'''Deano Rebel Bases Force Drain Deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Deano]]
* '''Published:''' July 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker)]]
* '''Strategy:''' Rebel Bases Force Drain Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDag Rebel Bases Force Drain Deck Deano.txt |Download]]
